paper_title: An improved limit on the axion-photon coupling from the CAST experiment
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on the y-axis of Figure 8
notes: CAST Phase I (vacuum) combined 2003+2004 result: g_agamma < 8.8e-11 GeV^-1 at 95% CL, valid (mass-independent) for m_a <~ 0.02 eV where axion-photon conversion is fully coherent. Encoded as flat two-point bound from 1e-5 eV (lower edge of exclusion plot in figure 8) up to 0.02 eV. Above 0.02 eV the limit degrades rapidly; the full exclusion line at higher masses is only shown graphically (figure 8) and not tabulated.
